posts.preview: Today, I am participating in the Parliamentary Women Caucus and Women’s Legislative Capacity Workshop, held jointly with the Namibia Joint Parliamentary Women Caucus.

The Namibia Women Parliamentarians Caucus (NWPC) is a cross-party and non-partisan parliamentary platform that brings together women legislators from the National Assembly and the National Council. Its overall purpose is to strengthen cooperation among women parliamentarians and advance gender equality through legis...
The Caucus is rooted in Namibia’s constitutional commitment to equality, regional and international gender commitments, and the institutional aspiration to build a more gender-sensitive Parliament.

I am pleased that Labour and the Private Sector will be added to the stakeholders’ list of the Parliamentary Women Caucus. This will strengthen engagement with key stakeholders and ensure that the voices and concerns of working women are reflected in our legislative and policy discussions See less
